topic: Bug fix and feedback on process
summary_markdown: The conversation centered on a bug related to frequency tracking. [me] confirmed that the task was received from someone (Lucas) and subsequently returned/fixed. The process for reporting bugs was praised, noting that the ticket provided by Lucas was excellent, including company numbers, names, full-size screenshots with URLs, and impersonalization. A hotfix was deployed following the fix. Feedback was also given to colleagues regarding the need to include all necessary parts of bug reports.
